You need fleeces, water- and wind-resistant fabrics and functional details such as elasticated cuffs and zipped gaiters to keep out the chill. For another, you’re looking for high-resistance staples that allow for a wide breadth of movements and easy turns. Last but not least, you’ll want kit that keeps you stylish, whatever the conditions.

Shoe Shine: Three Smart Shoes From Mr P.
https://www.mrporter.com/en-gb/journal/f.teaser: Every year, winter brings a familiar predicament: which shoes are we meant to wear when it’s cold, wet, or both? There’s certainly no shortage of shoes worth our attention on the MR PORTER shelves, but Shoe Shine is an attempt to narrow the field: each week, three pairs that have caught our eye. Starting with our own label, Mr P. The brand’s footwear is designed at our HQ in London and made by a small group of independent manufacturers in Italy and Portugal, each chosen for what they do best. A fourth-generation shoemaker in Naples handles the fine leather and hand finishings; a family workshop near Lago d’Orta makes the softer styles, while a Tuscan business with more than 70 years’ experience makes the sandals. The idea is to approach each shoe individually, rather than apply one method across the entire collection.
